From: Alex Morgan <alex.morgan@lighthousefin.com>
To: Sean Gallagher <sean.gallagher@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 2 Mar 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Demo request from pricing page (budget intent)

Hi Sean,

I just filled out the demo form on your pricing page — Lighthouse Financial is evaluating inference providers for customer-facing assistants. We have a clear budget bucket and want to see end-to-end latency and cost tradeoffs.

Can we get a 30–45 minute walkthrough next week? I'm based in PST. Folks who would join: me (Alex), Pat Liu (engineering lead).

A few quick things we care about:
- predictable p95 latency at 512 tokens
- batching/caching strategies for user sessions
- private deployment options (VPC)

Thanks,
Alex Morgan
Head of Platform
Lighthouse Financial
alex.morgan@lighthousefin.com
(415) 555-0198

Quick suggestion: 30 minutes to cover platform overview + pricing levers, then optional 15–20 minute deep dive with one of our SEs for latency/infra details. Does any of the below work for you (PST)?
- Wed 3/3: 10:00–10:30am or 3:00–3:30pm
- Thu 3/4: 11:00–11:30am

If those don't fit, tell us a couple of windows and we'll make it work. I've attached a one-page demo agenda.

Best,

- Can you share a representative request pattern (avg tokens per request, concurrency expectations)?
- Are you planning for user-facing assistants with session affinity / long-lived KV caches?

If you prefer not to share sample traffic here, a high-level note is fine. I'll bring a short slide with p95 examples and a couple of quantization/config suggestions tailored to budget vs latency tradeoffs.

See you tomorrow — joining link is the Google Meet in the calendar invite.
